title: 2007 AMC 12B Problem 11
statement: The angles of quadrilateral \(ABCD\) satisfy \(\angle A=2\angle B=3\angle C=4\angle D.\) What is the degree measure of \(\angle A,\) rounded to the nearest whole number?

solutions.text:
Let \(x=\angle A.\) Then \(\angle B=\tfrac x2,\) \(\angle C=\tfrac x3,\) and \(\angle D=\tfrac x4.\)

The angle sum gives \[ x+\dfrac x2+\dfrac x3+\dfrac x4=\dfrac{25x}{12}=360, \] so \(x=\dfrac{12\cdot360}{25}=172.8\approx173.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
